decisions.reason: The source defines how rejected clips count toward the monthly quota; it does not change the deferred trial batch assignment.
The source adds a quota consequence for any substandard clip but does not change the white-text-only or no-text-effects standards.
The treatment of rejected clips does not alter permitted source content or source-selection exclusions.
The dedicated account remains intended for posting approved clips; excluding rejected clips from the production quota does not change account provisioning or purpose.
The source explains the quota treatment of clips that fail quality review but does not change the clean-editing standard or prohibited visual treatments.
The complete, standalone narrative standard remains unchanged; the source only defines the quota consequence when quality standards are not met.
The source does not modify the hook-selection criterion and only clarifies how unapproved clips are treated in the monthly quota.
The requirement to select substantive moments is unchanged; correction and quota exclusion are consequences owned by the monthly output requirement.
The source concerns approval and quota counting before posting, not the metrics or transparency used to track posted clips.
The exact-font requirement remains unchanged; the source provides only a general quota consequence for clips below the quality standard.
The 20-to-120-second duration limits are not changed by the rule excluding rejected clips from the monthly quota until correction.
